importerRecovery.durability: batch write then fsync both partials before atomic checkpoint rename
importerRecovery.resume: validates bindings, truncates to durable byte lengths, rebuilds ID/key/content state, re-decompresses and skips committed rows
importerRecovery.freshRerun: refuses any existing final, checkpoint, or partial target

releaseManager.confinement: lexical direct-child validation plus lstat symbolic-link/junction rejection and physical realpath direct-child validation
releaseManager.verification: requires completed manifest and accepted/quarantine hashes before seal or pointer mutation
releaseManager.immutability: seal binds run name, import run ID, manifest/output/quarantine hashes, and content identity
releaseManager.pointer: current.json written through same-directory temporary file then atomic rename
releaseManager.rollback: verifies sealed history target before atomic pointer change
